notes.title: Dungeons of Edera 2 Alpha Play Test is now OPEN!
notes.notes:
Mercs,

The alpha play test for Dungeons of Edera is NOW OPEN! We will keep it open for approximately 2 weeks. If you do participate, please leave feedback and report bugs in our discord!


[h1]As a reminder[/h1]

It will be single player only for this first test, on our static test map (Our dungeon generation is still WIP). Players will be limited to the Paladin Class (With all spells available for unlock - Advanced spells in the future will have level gating) and most of the Hub features are not available except for stash/store. We will keep the play test open for approximately 2 weeks.

[h2]Goals of this early test are[/h2]
Early feedback on core gameplay loop
Combat/spells/level up feedback
Early performance signals on various hardware
Overall look and feel feedback
Ideas to enhance the user experience


[h2]How do I sign up[/h2]
Opt into the play test on the main Dungeons of Edera 2 steam page!


[h3]Our ask is if you do check it out, you give us feedback on the survey that is available in the main menu!
Looking forward to hearing your feedback![/h3]

Cheers,
Monster Tooth

notes.title: Welcome to Dungeons of Edera 2
notes.notes:
Introducing Dungeons of Edera 2, the latest project from Monster Tooth Studios! As a passionate three-person indie team, we're dedicated to crafting an exceptional gaming experience. 

We've been fielding numerous questions from the community about what sets Dungeons of Edera 2 apart from its predecessor. We're excited to share that DOE2 will boast significant improvements in three key areas.

First and foremost, we're thrilled to introduce 4 player Co-op, allowing you to experience the game with friends in a whole new way. Additionally, our Art Direction has undergone a major overhaul, resulting in enhanced visuals and atmosphere that will fully immerse you in the world. Lastly, we've focused on improving the Fluidity of Combat, ensuring smoother, more responsive combat mechanics for a better overall gameplay experience. Additionally, a new equilibrium system has been introduced, preventing characters from being getting stun locked to death.

The storyline is a continuation from the first game, but with a twist. Instead of controlling a single hero, players take on the role of a mercenary organization assisting factions in war via contracts. The choices made during these missions will gain or lose favor with factions, influencing the availability of faction-specific classes, crafting, and bonuses.

Upon reaching maximum level and completing the storyline, players will have access to challenge dungeons. These dungeons focus on acquiring additional strength for characters through loot and feature various challenges, including timed dungeons, arena-style boss fights, and survival mode.

The game's procedural dungeon generation has also undergone significant improvements. Moving away from predesigned dungeon chunks, the game now generates totally random dungeons at the beginning of each run. Each dungeon includes several "points of interest" with concentrated enemies and loot, as well as boss areas where players will be locked in until they emerge victorious or defeated.

[b]We are planning a play test this winter, join our discord for more info! Thank you for your support![/b]
